The '''Demon Academy Stars''' are limited capsules from '''Update 12''' that granted the player a '''random mythic unit''' from Update 12 and could be obtained by purchasing them from Issai for 650 Demon Academy Symbols.

==Information==
*<span style="color:#FFC208;">+Guaranteed to contain one of 3 Limited Demon Academy Mythic Units</span>
*<span style="color:#921296;">''"I'm fine with being fool. If there's no way I can win with my abilities, then I'll stick with being a fool to the end!"''</span>
